title: Lesson 51 · Reward for virtue
titleZh: 第51课 对美德的奖赏

examples.en: My friend Hugh has always been fat.
He decided to go on a diet.
He wrote out a list of forbidden foods.
examples.zh: 他列了一张禁食食物清单。

examples.en: The list included most of the things he loves.
examples.zh: 清单包括他爱吃的大部分东西。

examples.en: He wrote out a long list of foods.
examples.zh: 他列出了一张长长的食物清单。

examples.en: I put some butter on the bread.
examples.zh: 我在面包上抹了些黄油。

examples.en: I bought some potatoes at the market.
examples.zh: 我在市场上买了一些土豆。

examples.en: The parcel contained five bars of chocolate.
The parcel contained three bags of sweets.
Yesterday I paid him a visit.
He hurriedly hid a large parcel under his desk.
examples.zh: 他急忙把一个大包裹藏到桌子底下。

examples.en: He had to reward himself occasionally.
examples.zh: 他不得不偶尔犒劳一下自己。

sentences.en: He began his diet a week ago.
Yesterday I paid him a visit.
He led me into his room and hurriedly hid a large parcel under his desk.
sentences.zh: 他把我领进房间，急急忙忙地把一个大包裹藏到桌子底下。

sentences.en: When I asked him what he was doing, he smiled guiltily and then put the parcel on the desk.
sentences.zh: 当我问他在干什么时，他内疚地笑了笑，然后把包裹放到了桌子上。

sentences.en: The parcel contained five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets!
sentences.zh: 包裹里有五大块巧克力和三袋糖果！

article.en: My friend Hugh has always been fat, but things got so bad recently that he decided to go on a diet.
article.zh: 我的朋友休一直很胖，但最近情况变得很糟，他决定节食。

article.en: He began his diet a week ago.
First of all, he wrote out a long list of all the foods which were forbidden.
article.zh: 首先，他列出了一张长长的禁食食物清单。

article.en: The list included most of the things Hugh loves: butter, potatoes, rice, beer, milk, chocolate and sweets.
article.zh: 清单上包括休爱吃的大部分东西：黄油、土豆、米饭、啤酒、牛奶、巧克力和糖果。

article.en: Yesterday I paid him a visit.
I rang the bell and was not surprised to see that Hugh was still as fat as ever.
article.zh: 我按了门铃，看到休还是那么胖，我一点也不感到奇怪。

article.en: He led me into his room and hurriedly hid a large parcel under his desk.
article.zh: 他把我领进房间，急急忙忙地把一个大包裹藏到桌子底下。

article.en: When I asked him what he was doing, he smiled guiltily and then put the parcel on the desk.
article.zh: 当我问他在干什么时，他内疚地笑了笑，然后把包裹放到了桌子上。

article.en: He explained that his diet was so strict that he had to reward himself occasionally.
article.zh: 他解释说他的节食太严格了，他不得不偶尔犒劳一下自己。

article.en: The parcel contained five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets!
article.zh: 包裹里有五大块巧克力和三袋糖果！
